periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, tilted at approximately a 45-degree angle downward from the medial to the lateral aspect.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Ovaloid morphology with a vertical-to-horizontal ratio of approximately 1.5:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering, with the lowest point of the patch extending towards the lower cheek, well below the ocular center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band covers the entirety of the visible shoulder region, though the full height of the torso is occluded by foreground vegetation.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The gap between the medial edges of the dark ear regions is approximately equal to the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The superior boundaries of the pinnae exhibit a smooth, consistently rounded circular curvature.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent horizontal linear scar or deep transverse cutaneous indentation is visible across the bridge of the muzzle between the eye patches.
other_distinctive_markers: Visible protrusion of the lower mandibular incisors during mastication.
